forex.title: Currency exchange
forex.intro: Check recent rate trends and buy/sell signals for major currencies.

trendDescription.up: The 20-day average has crossed above the 60-day average and is still rising. The won may keep weakening (rate going up), so read both buy and sell signals with care.
trendDescription.down: The 20-day average has dropped below the 60-day average and is still falling. The rate may keep going down.
trendDescription.sideways: There's no clear direction right now. Mean reversion (buy low, sell high) tends to work relatively well in this phase.

forex.trendBasis: The trend combines where MA20 sits relative to MA60 with MA20's 5-day slope.

ma20.label: 20-day average
ma20.description: The average rate over the last 20 business days. If the current rate is above it, it's relatively expensive in the short term; below it, relatively cheap.

ma60.label: 60-day average
ma60.description: The average rate over the last 60 business days. It shows the longer trend. When the 20-day average crosses above the 60-day average, it's read as an uptrend signal.

rsi14.label: Short-term heat
rsi14.description: Shows on a 0–100 scale how overbought or oversold the rate has been over the last 14 days. Above 70 means overbought (may fall soon); below 30 means oversold (may rise soon).

percentile52w.label: Position in the year
percentile52w.description: Where the current rate ranks among the last year (about 252 business days) of rates, from 0 to 100%. Below 25% is near the yearly low; above 75% is near the high.

percentile13w.label: Position in 3 months
percentile13w.description: Where the current rate ranks among the last 3 months (about 63 business days). It helps spot short-term lows and highs even during long trends. Below 20% is a recent quarterly low; above 80% is a quarterly high.
